case_studies.title: Welcome from Eric Brennan
case_studies.excerpt: A welcome message to the AmeriLife recruiting community.
case_studies.content:
Welcome to the Recruiting Hub. Here you will find proven campaigns, playbooks, and success stories from across our affiliate network.

THE OPPORTUNITY IN TODAY'S ENVIRONMENT

Recruiting top talent requires consistency, speed, and the right tools. Use the campaigns below to accelerate your pipeline.

case_studies.title: ORCA's Indeed Speed Dating Campaign
case_studies.excerpt: How ORCA used Indeed speed-dating events to fill agent seats faster.
case_studies.content:
ORCA launched a speed-dating style recruiting event on Indeed that shortened time-to-hire and improved candidate quality.

THE OPPORTUNITY IN TODAY'S ENVIRONMENT

Speed and clarity win in a competitive recruiting market. ORCA's playbook shows how structured events create momentum.

1. LEAD WITH THE NEED

Start every conversation with the candidate's goals, not the product catalog.
